description: Build nextjs-file-saas starter - File conversion, storage, and media processing with Clerk, Neon/Drizzle, Cloudflare R2, Inngest, and Stripe
steps: Create nextjs-file-saas/ directory with .gitignore

Create package.json with exact-pinned deps: next@15.3.4, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, @clerk/nextjs, drizzle-orm, stripe, inngest, @aws-sdk/client-s3 (for R2), pg. DevDeps: typescript@5.8.3, vitest@3.2.1, fast-check@3.23.2, eslint@9.28.0, eslint-config-next@15.3.4, tailwindcss@4.1.10, @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10, postcss@8.5.4, drizzle-kit, @types/pg, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom

Create starter.json matching catalog entry (id:8, choices:R2 + Inngest, technologies:[TypeScript, Clerk, Neon, Drizzle, Cloudflare R2, Inngest, Stripe], auth:Clerk, data:Neon + Drizzle, monetization:Stripe, integrations:[Cloudflare R2, Inngest])

Create drizzle/schema.ts with tables: fileAssets (id, userId, fileName, fileKey, fileSize, mimeType, status enum [uploaded,processing,ready,failed], uploadedAt, createdAt), conversionJobs (id, fileAssetId, userId, outputFormat, status enum [pending,processing,completed,failed], attempts, maxAttempts, error, startedAt, completedAt, createdAt), outputAssets (id, conversionJobId, fileKey, fileName, fileSize, mimeType, createdAt), subscriptions (id, userId, stripeCustomerId, stripeSubscriptionId, stripePriceId, status enum [active,past_due,cancelled,trialing], currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, storageQuotaBytes, createdAt, updatedAt), processedEvents (id, providerEventId unique, eventType, processedAt). Include drizzle/migrations/ with initial SQL.
Create drizzle.config.ts
Create domain/entities.ts with types for FileAsset (with FileStatus), ConversionJob (with JobStatus), OutputAsset, Subscription (with SubscriptionStatus), ProcessedEvent

Create domain/policies.ts with: AuthContext (userId), canUploadFile (authenticated + under storage quota), canStartConversion (file owner + active subscription), canDownloadOutput (conversion job owner), canViewFiles (owner only). Include file validation: ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES, MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES. Deny-by-default.

Create lib/server/config.ts with ConfigSpec for: CLERK_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, INNGEST_EVENT_KEY, INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY, R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET_NAME, R2_PUBLIC_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts with AppError, BillingError, WebhookVerificationError, FileSizeError, FileTypeError, QuotaExceededError, RetryExhaustedError, sanitizeProviderError
Create lib/server/auth.ts with Clerk adapter
Create lib/server/billing.ts with BillingPort and StripeAdapter with HMAC webhook verification
Create lib/server/billing-fake.ts with FakeBillingAdapter
Create lib/server/storage.ts with ObjectStorePort (uploadFile, deleteFile, getSignedUrl) and R2Adapter with MIME/extension/byte validation BEFORE storage
Create lib/server/storage-fake.ts with FakeObjectStoreAdapter enforcing same limits in memory
Create lib/server/jobs.ts with JobPort (startConversion, getJobStatus) and InngestAdapter with bounded retries and terminal failure state
Create lib/server/jobs-fake.ts with FakeJobAdapter simulating conversion lifecycle
Create lib/server/database.ts with Drizzle client
Create lib/server/providers.ts
Create middleware.ts protecting /dashboard with Clerk
Create app/page.tsx - public landing page describing file conversion service
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected dashboard (upload files, view conversions, quota display)
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - verified Stripe webhook
Create app/api/inngest/route.ts - Inngest serve endpoint for conversion jobs
Create app/api/upload/route.ts - file upload endpoint with validation before R2 storage
Create next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts
Create .env.example
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts testing file validation, quota, ownership
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts
Create tests/unit/server/storage.test.ts testing MIME/size validation
Create tests/unit/server/jobs.test.ts testing conversion job lifecycle and terminal failure
Create tests/integration/upload.test.ts testing upload -> conversion -> output flow
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts (Property 4) - ownership + quota
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts (Property 5) for Stripe
Create tests/property/retry-termination.test.ts (Property 8) - conversion jobs terminate
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts
Create README.md documenting file processing, R2 setup, Inngest jobs, Stripe billing, deployment
Run pnpm install, lint, typecheck, test, build
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-file-saas/ directory exists with all required files
pnpm install succeeds with committed lockfile
pnpm lint, typecheck, test, build all pass
Property 4, 5, and 8 tests present and passing
File validation (MIME type + size) enforced before R2 storage
Conversion jobs have bounded retry with terminal failure
R2, Inngest, and Stripe adapters have fakes
.env.example covers Clerk, Neon, Stripe, Inngest, R2
findings: Built nextjs-file-saas from scratch (FileAsset/ConversionJob/OutputAsset/Subscription domain, Clerk + Neon/Drizzle + Cloudflare R2 + Inngest + Stripe). Implemented deny-by-default policies including storage-quota gating (canUploadFile) and ownership/subscription-status gating for conversions/downloads. Upload validation (MIME allowlist + MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) is enforced in lib/server/storage.ts's validateFile() BEFORE any object write, shared by both the R2ObjectStoreAdapter and FakeObjectStoreAdapter, and wired into app/api/upload/route.ts so oversized/disallowed uploads return 413/415 without touching storage or persisting a FileAsset. Job retries reuse the same bounded-retry state-machine pattern proven in nextjs-automation-saas (executeConversionWithBoundedRetry), guaranteeing conversion jobs never exceed maxAttempts and always reach a terminal completed (with OutputAsset)/failed state. 84 tests pass across 10 files: unit (policies, billing, storage, jobs), integration (upload->conversion->output flow including rejected-upload cases, auth), smoke (module imports), and property tests for Property 4 (auth + quota consistency), Property 5 (webhook authenticity), and Property 8 (job retry termination, 200+ runs). pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, lint, typecheck, test, and build all pass with 0 errors/warnings.
